title: Our bot survived the crash — but the LIVE account behaved very differently from the backtest
author: profittoinvest
selftext:
We recently got a very clear example of how much portfolio management can change the result of an automated strategy.

Our Cornix backtest from July 4, 2026 currently shows roughly:

**+122% return**  
**\~44% max drawdown (last week)**

Our LIVE BingX account over the same period is around:

**+259% (+17,02% last week)**

The entries are based on the same core strategy.

The difference is mainly in the portfolio controls we apply LIVE.

When the market enters a bearish regime, we use two additional rules:

* confirmed EMA20/50 bearish cross → close remaining LONG positions 12h later
* while bearish, cap LONG exposure at 45%

We also keep a global portfolio tilt limit of 70%, so in the bearish regime we normally keep the portfolio within roughly:

**30–45% LONG**  
**55–70% SHORT**

This matters because the system is portfolio-based.

If several SHORT trades close in sequence, the remaining portfolio can suddenly become heavily LONG. In that situation we block or close new LONG positions until the required balance is restored.

We do this even if a particular LONG signal looks attractive.

The decision is based on portfolio mathematics and rules tested historically back to 2020, not on trying to predict the next candle.

The interesting problem is that Cornix cannot fully reproduce all these manual interventions in its backtest.

Once LIVE skips or closes a few trades differently, the two paths start to compound differently because capital availability and portfolio exposure are no longer the same.

So we now have a very visible divergence:

**raw bot / Cornix backtest: +122%**  
**LIVE with portfolio controls: +259%**

We are also testing whether copy trading can solve this problem.

If followers can replicate our master portfolio directly, they may no longer need to manually manage LONG/SHORT exposure themselves.

At the same time we are testing execution on other exchanges, including BingX, Bitget, KuCoin, BloFin, OKX and OKX EU. On OKX EU the protection logic is already implemented directly in code.

You can find more information on our Discord: [https://discord.gg/9b2XrAnbF](https://discord.gg/9b2XrAnbF)

For me the biggest lesson is:

**A profitable signal does not automatically create a profitable portfolio. Portfolio structure matters.**

Curious how others solve this when followers join at different times and therefore start with completely different positions and capital availability.
